home.seoDescription: Get custom die-cut stickers in any design, size, or style. High-quality offset printing and fast shipping in just 8-10 business days.
home.content:
Make Your Brand Stand Out With Custom Die Cut Stickers

When it comes to stickers, it is always quality and creativity that go hand in hand. Here at The Die Cut Stickers, we have premium quality custom die cut stickers that will give your branding or personal project an upgrade. With such a wide variety of options, these stickers are not just a pretty face; they are a communication means, a tool to draw attention and convey your idea. 

Custom Die Cut Stickers for Every Need

Die cut stickers are made for you and your needs and the unique sticker will surely gain anyone’s attention. If you require stickers for business, identification, or as giveaways, these stickers are ideal for branding and attracting attention. That is why we use superior quality for our stickers so that they can last both inside and outside.

We provide a complete package of sticker products such as holographic die cut stickers and stickers with the fastest shipment to meet your demands. Whenever you have the need for stickers it will be quite easy to find one type, or design that will suit your needs.

Sticker Types to Choose From

Our personalized die cut stickers come in two main types. They are constructed from strong materials, but they are used for different functions. 

Die-Cut Labels

These are perfect if you want to print your product brand, or labeled boxes, or if you want to engrave your business tools. For your small logo stickers or large labels, you are assured of high-quality prints that put across your message boldly.

Die-Cut Decals

The ideal for even larger uses, decals are best for any walls, windows, cars, or even huge promotional objects. They can be used outdoors or make sure your branding will last.

Shape, Size, and Customization

At The Die Cut Stickers, we appreciate the fact that each sticker has its own use. Therefore, we have the option to order the stickers in the shape and size you choose. Everything from miniature labels for products to enormous graphics for automobiles, possibilities extend as far as creativity.

Shapes

Our die cut stickers can be in any shape from traditional shapes like a square or circle to logo like a personalized logo and complex shapes. Cutting is possible in a way that allows for shapes that are specific and fit into the said design without fail.

Sizes

Whether you require custom small stickers for labeling a product or a large design to be used on a vehicle or store, you can be sure that our stickers are available in a variety of sizes. You make the call on what size is optimal for your needs for your specific project.

Materials That Make a Difference

The type of material that you decide to use in producing your stickers must be carefully decided because it determines the sticker’s quality, design, and texture. Where we are based at The Die Cut Stickers, we ensure we use the best quality materials that do not fade easily.

Die Cut Vinyl Stickers

We have some of the most durable die cut vinyl stickers you will find in the market. Most are water-resistant, wear-resistant, and UV resistant meaning they can be used in and outdoors. Suitable for your car’s name, work signs, and durable product logo.

Matte & Glossy Stickers

Both simple looking matte ones and brilliant reflective glossy ones are available for a variety of brands. For that bright and shiny look that gets noticed, nothing can beat gloss stickers while for a smooth, classy look for branding, matte stickers work best.

Eco-Friendly Options

For the customers who value our planet, we present environmentally friendly stickers. They are recyclable and sustainable. Whenever you want people to see your brand as environmentally conscious, ordering our eco-friendly stickers is a perfect way to go.

Custom Coatings for a Polished Finish

The top and bottom of your custom die cut stickers are one area that should not be overlooked when you think of the finish. Its adaptability is that we have different types of coatings that can be used to give the design an added richness.

Matte Coating

As for the surface finish, the matte coating gives a subtle and smooth color free from reflection. It’s perfect for Minimalist design themes, or for brands that wish to offer their customers a more calming and luxurious feel.

Gloss Coating

The gloss finish enhances the brightness of colors that give your designed project to have a shiny-looking polish. If you need something with a little more oomph and glam then nothing pleases like having glossy stickers.

Spot UV

Spot UV is a method of using a high-gloss varnish on selected parts of the design leaving the rest of the paper matte. This coating also gives extra dimension and roughness, which emphasizes significant sections of your design.

Soft-Touch Coating

Used in industrial designs or in adding feel and styles to furniture soft-touch coating is ideal since it has a velvety appearance. This coating gives the stickers a nice touch and boosts the aesthetic value of your stickers.

High-Quality Printing & Colors That Pop

Our die cut stickers are a self-adhesive specialty that is printed using modern techniques to ensure perfect matching color. It matters if you need a colorful design or a design with a rich tone, our method of printing reflects your masterpiece. Foil stamping and embossing can further enhance your design and create even more luxury stickers from your artwork.

Use Cases for Custom Die Cut Stickers

Die cut stickers are very useful. You can use them in various ways. The following are some of the uses of custom die cut stickers. 

Here are some of the most common uses:

Custom Car Stickers

Our die cut car stickers are great when looking to add a little character to a vehicle. Outdoor and long-lasting, these stickers might be useful in promoting your firm or just in expressing your own personality.

Outdoor Stickers

The die cut vinyl stickers that we offer for outdoor use are created to withstand all forms of weather. Whether as a mobile billboard for your business, car decals, or an outdoor sign, these stickers can withstand all that nature will throw at it.

Indoor Stickers

If you want to have stickers for indoors such as at windows, for products, or special occasions, we recommend indoor stickers. They are ideal for long-term use. 

Custom Packaging Labels

Stand out with your products by using labels to meet your company’s branding needs. Whether on your product or in your promotional campaigns, our custom die cut labels will help you stand out.

Custom Reusable Stickers

Our custom reusable stickers are perfect for brands who want a product that is sustainable and can be used daily. You can place these stickers where you want. Therefore, it makes it ideal for companies in search of good branding particularly on permanent materials.

Bulk Die Cut Stickers

Need a large quantity? No problem! This means you can order our die cut stickers in large quantities, which means as many as you want at a reasonable price for a large quantity.

Holographic Die Cut Stickers

If you are in the mood to stand out, then our holographic die cut stickers are an ideal option. These stickers possess an unusual metallic finish that shifts in colour when viewed from different perspectives and therefore are great for a range of promotional products or items that have a seasonal or special release.

Custom Logo Stickers

Our custom die cut logo stickers are perfect for advertising your company’s brand or for customizing the logo for the product boxes. Attractive colors will increase your brand's exposure and be memorable.

Fast Shipping, Great Prices

Our clients may sometimes be tight on time. Therefore, we offer convenient options to let us know where you would like your stickers to be shipped and how soon. Besides, we also make sure that they obtain quality custom die-cut stickers from us at fairly affordable prices.

Why Choose The Die Cut Stickers?

We offer the best quality custom die cut stickers with options of materials, sizes, finishes, and custom shapes. Are you looking for bulk custom die cut stickers, labels, or designs of your preference? worry not, we offer it all to you. Furthermore, being an environmentally friendly company, we meet your demands for any sticker in the shortest time possible.

Join The Die Cut Stickers today and give your brand the unique look it deserves. Contact us at email info@thediecutstickers.com or by calling (503) 358-0443.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.content:
At The Die Cut Stickers, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you interact with our website, https://thediecutstickers.com/ (the "Site").

1. Information We Collect

We collect various types of information when you use our Site, including:

  • Personal Information: This includes your name, email address, phone number, and other contact information you provide when you fill out forms or place an order.
  • Payment Information: When you make a purchase, we collect payment details, including your credit card number and billing address, to process your order securely.
  • Automatically Collected Information: We may collect information such as your IP address, browser type, and browsing behavior through cookies and similar tracking technologies.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the information collected for the following purposes:

  • To process and fulfill your orders.
  • To communicate with you about your order, inquiries, or other requests.
  • To improve our website, services, and customer experience.
  • To send you promotional offers, updates, and marketing materials (you can opt out of these communications at any time).
  • To monitor and analyze website usage and trends to better understand how our visitors use the Site.

3. Sharing Your Information

We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personally identifiable information to third parties without your consent, except in the following cases:

  • Service Providers: We may share your information with third-party service providers who assist us in operating our website, processing payments, and delivering products.
  • Legal Requirements: We may disclose your information if required to do so by law or if we believe such action is necessary to comply with legal processes, protect our rights, or ensure the safety of our users.

4. Data Security

We implement a variety of security measures to ensure the safety of your personal information. Our Site is equipped with SSL (Secure Socket Layer) encryption to protect data transmission. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

5. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

Our Site uses cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience. Cookies help us understand your preferences based on previous or current site activity, enabling us to provide you with improved services. You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings, but this may affect the functionality of our Site.

6. Third-Party Links

Our Site may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or the content of these external sites. We encourage you to read the privacy policies of any website you visit through our links.

7. Your Choices

You have the right to access, update, or delete the personal information we hold about you. To do so, please contact us at . You can also opt out of receiving promotional emails by following the instructions in those emails.

8. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. The updated version will be posted on this page with the new effective date.

refund_returns.title: Refund and Returns Policy
refund_returns.content:
Return and Refund Policy

At The Die Cut Stickers, we are committed to providing high-quality custom stickers and packaging solutions. If you're not satisfied with your order, please read our return and refund policy below.

Returns

We accept returns for defective and non-defective products, subject to the following conditions:

  • Items must be unused, in new condition, and returned in their original packaging.

  • You must submit your return request within 10 days of receiving your order.

  • Returns are only accepted by mail. We do not support in-person or drop-off returns.

  • A return label is included in the package for your convenience.

  • We do not charge any restocking fee.

To begin a return, email info@thediecutstickers.com with your order number, details about the issue, and photos (if applicable).

Exchanges

We offer exchanges if the item meets our return conditions. A replacement will be issued once the original product is returned and inspected.

Refunds

Once we receive and inspect your returned item:

  • Refunds will be processed within 10 business days.

  • Refunds are issued to your original payment method.

  • All refunds are processed in USD (United States Dollars).

Non-Returnable Items

  • Custom-printed stickers or die-cut products unless they are defective

  • Used, damaged, or altered items not due to our error

  • Items returned after the 10-day window

Contact Us

For return requests or questions:

Phone: (503) 358-0443
Address: 3409 N 7th Ave Unit #529 Phoenix, AZ 85013
